review_type: Targeted critical literature review, not a systematic review, meta-analysis or reproduction of paper experiments.
selection: Primary proceedings, journals, author/arXiv full texts and academic books; method/result/limitations reading prioritized over promotional summaries. English-language and access-related selection bias remains.

papers.title: GEO: Generative Engine Optimization
papers.design: GEO-bench 10,000 queries; evaluation on 1,000-query test split; top-5 Google sources supplied; 5 response seeds; Perplexity file-upload subset of 200
papers.finding_used: Controlled text changes within already available candidates; attribution-weighted word-count and subjective impression
papers.limits: Candidate entry into organic web search and search ranking were not measured. File uploads in the deployed-engine test bypassed organic source discovery. Relative impression gains are not recommendation probabilities.
papers.inspection: Full HTML methods, Tables 1/5, limitations and Appendix C.1 inspected

papers.title: C-SEO Bench: Does Conversational SEO Work?
papers.design: 2 tasks, 6 domains, about 16.3k documents; 10 rewrite methods; 4 proprietary model configurations; multi-actor adoption
papers.finding_used: Citation ordering under fixed candidate contexts; many rewrites gave no gain or reduced ranking; strong position effects
papers.limits: The SEO baseline moves documents within an LLM context; it does not establish a particular real-web SEO intervention. English only. Its outcome differs from GEO word attribution.
papers.inspection: Proceedings confirmed; full arXiv HTML methods, sections 6.1–6.4 and limitations inspected

papers.title: SAGEO Arena: A Realistic Environment for Evaluating Search-Augmented Generative Engine Optimization
papers.design: 2,700 queries, 9 domains, 171,003 documents; modular retrieval/reranking/generation; BM25 plus dense/hybrid checks
papers.finding_used: Stage visibility after rewriting and reindexing; changes useful to generation can lose retrieval/reranking visibility; structural fields matter in this controlled system
papers.limits: Targets start in the baseline reranker top-10; not a new-brand indexing experiment. Static indexed corpus and chosen model/field weights do not reproduce commercial search, link signals or user signals.
papers.inspection: Full v2 HTML including corpus construction, stage-level metrics, model substitutions and Appendix D inspected

papers.title: What Drives AI Citations? Content, Retrieval and Model Knowledge in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
papers.review_status: arXiv manuscript; peer-reviewed venue not confirmed
papers.design: Two 90-day English commercial datasets: 158,099 answers and 468,037 citations; engine API replays and controlled answer-stage tests
papers.finding_used: Separates within-website page features, engine retrieval and brand prior; replay retrieval explained more variation than the observed page features
papers.limits: Associational main design; one-time post-collection page fetch with missing pages; API replay after collection differs from consumer UI; US English, author-operated monitoring platform; no demonstrated effect of editing a model prior.
papers.inspection: Full official arXiv HTML fetched; sections 3–8 and experimental/limitation details inspected

papers.title: How Generative AI Disrupts Search: An Empirical Study of Google Search, Gemini, and AI Overviews
papers.design: 11,500 benchmark queries; 14,212 including additional time-sensitive sets; Google SERP, AIO and Gemini 2.5 Flash
papers.finding_used: Source sets and repeatability differ across engines and query variants
papers.limits: Descriptive snapshot of Google systems, partly API-collected; not an intervention study or a Claude/current Auto-mode evaluation. Google-Extended associations do not identify a causal crawler policy effect.
papers.inspection: University-hosted PDF methods and limitations inspected; PDF page 7 Figure 6/Table 4 visually checked

papers.title: The attribution crisis in LLM search results: Estimating ecosystem exploitation
papers.design: 13,929 cleaned answer observations from March–April 2025 Search Arena; 7,000 paired original queries; 11 model variants
papers.finding_used: Search-log URLs and answer citations differ; traces themselves can be incomplete
papers.limits: Provider-disclosed logs are proxies, not verified reads; filtered traces and older API models limit inference. A citation miss cannot by itself prove a retrieval miss.
papers.inspection: Publisher full text, publication date, variable definitions, descriptive tables and trace limitations inspected

papers.title: Media Source Matters More Than Content: Unveiling Political Bias in LLM-Generated Citations
papers.design: AllSides-2024: 1,340 queries, 2,680 passages, 169 outlets; dual-document content/source comparisons
papers.finding_used: Source identity can affect generated citations independently of text stance in this news setting
papers.limits: News/political identities and two-document candidate contexts do not establish software-brand authority effects in organic search.
papers.inspection: ACL metadata and paper PDF dataset/pipeline/controlled-source methods inspected

papers.title: Authority Bias in Conversational Search Engines for Academic Paper Recommendation
papers.design: 1,250 papers in 25 topics; 8 LLMs; content-identical original/flipped/boosted authority metadata; in-context top-1 choices
papers.finding_used: Authority metadata can change choices with the same title/abstract; explanations understate behavioral bias
papers.limits: Academic metadata is not software brand evidence. In-context candidates are supplied; no real-web candidate generation.
papers.inspection: Official ACL PDF acquired; methods, validity limits and page 4 dataset/authority-weight table visually inspected

papers.title: Answer Bubbles: Information Exposure in AI-Mediated Search
papers.design: 11,000 NQ-derived queries across 5 systems; content-coverage analysis on a 1,100-query subset
papers.finding_used: Cited sources and content actually represented in a synthesis differ; source length associates with measured coverage
papers.limits: Predominantly information-seeking English questions, one-time/location snapshot; entailment and max-over-chunk coverage are noisy and length-sensitive; no causal shortest-page rule.
papers.inspection: Official ACL PDF acquired; data collection, coverage methods and limitations inspected; page 7 methods/results visually checked

papers.title: Source Coverage and Citation Bias in LLM-based vs. Traditional Search Engines
papers.review_status: arXiv manuscript; peer-reviewed venue not confirmed
papers.design: 55,936 query corpus; 6 generative search platforms and Google/Bing; 2025 US trends and related questions
papers.finding_used: User-facing source mixes differ; generative systems also surface less-popular and unique domains
papers.limits: Only user-facing citations, not all retrieved pages; source-feature associations/classifiers are not causal rewrite effects; topical/temporal sampling bias.
papers.inspection: Full HTML data collection and HTML-feature/prediction methods and limits inspected

papers.title: Generative Engine Optimization: How to Dominate AI Search
papers.review_status: arXiv manuscript; peer-reviewed venue not confirmed
papers.design: Multiple ranking-style brand queries by region, category, language and paraphrase; source-type classification
papers.finding_used: Reports substantial third-party-source use and engine/language differences in its sampled commercial questions
papers.limits: Observational, query generation and automatic labels; broad strategic prescriptions exceed causal evidence. Do not generalize a fixed earned-media share to all software queries or later engines.
papers.inspection: Full HTML methodological pipeline, software/brand/language results and source classification inspected

papers.title: What Gets Cited: Competitive GEO in AI Answer Engines
papers.review_status: arXiv manuscript; peer-reviewed venue not confirmed
papers.design: 100 seed product articles; 1,440 synthetic paired scenarios; 18 factors, 6 models and 252,000 repeated trials
papers.finding_used: Conditional first-citation preference in two injected, anonymized sources; relevance and order are important
papers.limits: Not organic search; synthetic/anonymized product contexts; repeated trials are not independent markets; some very large odds ratios have singular-fit or degenerate-Hessian warnings.
papers.inspection: Full HTML factorial methods, Table 2 warnings and limitations inspected

papers.title: From Citation Selection to Citation Absorption: A Measurement Framework for Generative Engine Optimization Across AI Search Platforms
papers.review_status: arXiv manuscript; peer-reviewed venue not confirmed
papers.design: 602 prompts; 21,143 reported search-layer citations and 23,745 feature records from an existing public project
papers.finding_used: Distinguishes citation breadth from answer contribution; FAQ-only association is not a universal benefit
papers.limits: Static descriptive report, taxonomy/measurement noise and unexecuted confirmatory specifications; no causal claim that FAQs harm or evidence containers guarantee visibility.
papers.inspection: Full HTML measurement/identification and limitations inspected

papers.title: Think Before Writing: Feature-Level Multi-Objective Optimization for Generative Citation Visibility
papers.design: GEO-Bench; fixed five retrieved sources plus an injected advertiser page; 13 features; NSGA-II; GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.5-flash and Qwen-plus answer generators
papers.finding_used: Feature-level multi-objective optimization improved conditional citation visibility over the unmodified injected page and heuristic rewrites in three controlled answer generators.
papers.limits: Upstream admission/ranking excluded explicitly; LLM-based quality scores do not verify facts; generated advertiser content and computational cost limit transfer; no organic consumer-UI visibility measurement.
papers.inspection: Official ACL metadata and PDF sections 3–4, Table 2, limitations and Appendix B/C inspected; PDF pages 5–6 visually checked

academic_books.title: Introduction to Information Retrieval
parts_reviewed: Chapter 8 precision/recall, ranked evaluation and representative query sets
academic_books.application: Separate corpus availability, retrieval relevance, ordering and end outcomes; classical IR principles are not a vendor GEO algorithm.

academic_books.title: Learning to Rank for Information Retrieval
academic_books.publisher: Foundations and Trends in Information Retrieval / now Publishers
parts_reviewed: Public 36-page publisher preview, including introductory ranking/evaluation material, not the whole 107-page monograph
academic_books.application: Learned relevance and query-level evaluation differ from a closed local BM25 fixture; preview access only is disclosed.

official_sources.scope: Google Search AI Overviews/AI Mode eligibility; not a universal Gemini-app contract.
Google crawl/index timing and owner-authorized URL inspection; not a promised waiting period.

supplement.inspection: Public code read, not executed; current main snapshot, not independently proven to be the exact 2024 run revision.
supplement.observation: Some rewrite prompts permit invented citations/quotes/hypothetical statistics; do not copy them as factual business claims.

excluded_as_evidence: Marketing summaries and commercial SEO checklists were discovery leads only, not evidence for causal claims.
Screened papers not reviewed in enough methodological detail were not added to the core count.
copyright: Only bibliography, short paraphrases and original analysis are committed. Downloaded full texts and rendered pages are not committed.

supplemental_search_check.purpose: Additional primary-source discovery check; these are actual supplementary queries, not a complete reconstructed search history.

screened_not_added.reason: Abstract-level screening only; controlled supplied-source scorer, not an organic intervention; methods not reviewed enough to count.
Abstract-level screening only; GEO detection, not evidence for the cause of the observed misses; methods not reviewed enough to count.
